scope: Targeted current official tool/platform documentation audit, not a paper review or systematic search.

sources.read_depth: Official project reference; selected update/licensing/dependency/CLI sections read, not the whole179KB file
sources.supported_use: EJS/runtime dependencies, API/CLI semantics, resume/archive, fragment concurrency, subtitle selection, error and finite-retry options
sources.limits: Documentation does not establish this environment can access YouTube; HEAD docs are distinct from the installed release.

sources.read_depth: Official license; full short file read
sources.limits: Bundled executables/dependencies have different licenses; do not apply the core license to acquired media.

sources.read_depth: Official version module; full short file read
sources.supported_use: HEAD version string2026.10.21 and recorded release commit
sources.limits: MainHEAD and release commit are different pins, even when version strings match.

sources.locators: Runtime requirements table; Manual Installation; Licensing

sources.read_depth: Official license; full short file read

sources.read_depth: Official online article; main size/distribution sections read
sources.locators: File size limits; Repository size limits; Distributing large binaries
sources.supported_use: 50MiB warning/100MiB block/browser25MiB; prefer small code repositories
sources.limits: Generic release-size text differs from release-specific article; use stricter bound and account-plan checks.

sources.read_depth: Official online article; repository-size and activity sections read
sources.supported_use: 10GB on-disk recommendation,2GB enforced push,100MB enforced single-object limit; generated files in object storage
sources.limits: Recommendations are not unlimited entitlements; same article names additional UI/operation limits.

sources.read_depth: Official online article; complete short main text read
sources.supported_use: LFS stores objects separately,2/4/5GB per-file plan limits; not supported by GitHubPages
sources.limits: Does not identify this account plan or authorize media redistribution.

sources.read_depth: Official online article; storage/bandwidth section read
sources.supported_use: Up to1000 assets/release; each under2GiB; no stated total size/bandwidth limit
sources.limits: No automatic rights basis to publish third-party recordings; use specific limit over generic conflicting phrasing.

sources.read_depth: Official online article; measurement,free allowances,budget sections read
sources.locators: How use is measured; Free use; Using more; Managing budget
sources.supported_use: Free/Pro10GiB storage+download allowance; whole binary versions and archive downloads count; budgets affect blocking/billing

sources.read_depth: Official project source; optional dependency pins inspected
sources.supported_use: Matched EJS dependency requirement for the inspected source
sources.limits: MainHEAD source pin is not a claim to be byte-identical to installed release.

sources.read_depth: Official implementation; selected subtitle/archive/skip-download methods inspected
sources.supported_use: Manual subtitles shadow same-language automatic captions; simulated/skipped media archive writes need forcing
sources.limits: No source-media extraction was performed during code inspection.

sources.read_depth: Official implementation; known-size check and download loop inspected
sources.locators: download(): Content-Length and max_filesize around lines200–230
sources.supported_use: Known-size cap depends on observed Content-Length; external raw-budget checks remain necessary
sources.limits: Does not claim every downloader/protocol has identical cap behavior.

sources.read_depth: Official online article; usage limits read
sources.supported_use: Published site<=1GB;100GB/month soft bandwidth;10min deploy timeout;10build/hour exception for customActions workflows
sources.limits: Static hosting quotas are separate from repository and LFS quotas.

sources.read_depth: Official maintained online setup guide; runtime and installation sections read
sources.locators: Step1/Step2 runtime tables and package-version matching
sources.supported_use: Only Deno default enabled; Node needs explicit selection; compatible EJS required; default extra installation
sources.limits: Remote-component delivery is unnecessary with installed compatible package; not a denial workaround.

sources.read_depth: Official maintained online FAQ; archive,dependencies,403/429 sections inspected
sources.locators: How to download only new videos; dependencies; HTTP errors
sources.supported_use: Archive records successful downloads; ffmpeg requirements; origin/bot errors differ from transport failures
sources.limits: Cookie/IP/proxy recipes present in the FAQ are explicitly not adopted for this task.

sources.read_depth: Official maintained online installation guide; pip/updates sections inspected
sources.locators: Using the release binary; With pip
sources.supported_use: Use supported installation/update routes and compatible dependency extras
sources.limits: No install command executed by the documentation reviewer.

retrieval: Ordinary HTTPS/Git via inherited session proxy and CA; TLS verification preserved.
